api_key.description: Optional bearer token for the search endpoint. Empty or absent = no Authorization header -- the cell filters the empty string, so `${SEARCH_API_KEY:-}` with the variable unset queries the endpoint anonymously.

description.purpose: Queries a generic search endpoint and emits the result list as one tool_result turn.
description.use_when: The `web_search` occupant of a tools hive, reached on hop.tool_name == 'web_search'. The endpoint must speak the generic {results:[...]} shape -- front a provider with a shim if it does not. Both of its values bind late from the environment: SEARCH_ENDPOINT and SEARCH_API_KEY, declared in this template's `requires.env`.
description.not_in_scope: No provider adapters, no result ranking, no pagination. A non-conforming response is not an error (result_count 0, body passed through). And NO `params.sandbox`: like `web_fetch` this cell carries none -- egress is its job, and the union this template declares says so out loud rather than leaving it to be discovered.
description.emits_meaning: messages[]: one tool_result turn, text = JSON result list (title/url/snippet per hit). hop.result_count: number of hits; error_code only on io_error/timeout/invalid_input.
description.consumes_meaning: messages[]: a tool_call turn whose text is JSON args {query}.
examples: {"query":"agetech telephony"} -> tool_result text '[{"title":...}]', hop { operation: 'web_search', result_count: 3 }
